systems.name: Custom Dealership CRM (Handle a Sale)
systems.summary: The CRM Jason built for Triple J and Handle a Sale, the sale desk the dealership closes sales on, are one system. He designed its lead-to-title data model, roles and validation, tested Supabase row-level security (RLS) policies, executed production schema migrations while preserving existing records, and shipped it on Vercel with Edge Functions for voice and texting webhooks. Three staff use it daily across inventory, deals and follow-up.

systems.name: Voice AI Inbound
systems.summary: Inbound voice AI that books appointments into the CRM and live-transfers unresolved calls to staff. Across August and September 2026 it averaged 41 inbound calls, 14 booked appointments and 4 CRM-matched vehicle sales per month ($15,000 a month in sale proceeds).
systems.note: Keep the word CRM-matched. Do not describe the sales as caused by the voice AI, and do not compute rates or percentages from these numbers.

systems.name: Prospecting Workflow Automation
systems.summary: A Python workflow that uses the Claude API to research Facebook Marketplace leads, write findings to the CRM, and generate SOP-based reply text for automatic follow-up.
systems.note: Triple J's live lead-research workflow. It is not Obavia's Reach, which is in development and not live.
